target: acceptance 7 — adding a mode changes no existing mode's output. Compared byte-for-byte against output captured from the pre-change binary via git.
cmd: mkdir -p .agentic/observability; printf "%s" '{"observability":{"enabled":true}}' > .agentic/config.json; cp "$FIXTURES/comprehension/events.jsonl" .agentic/observability/events-20260801.jsonl; unset CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR AGENTIC_OBSERVE; ok=1; for m in cost phase spec estimate mix; do new=$("$PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/observe_metrics.sh" "$m" 2>/dev/null | shasum | cut -d" " -f1); git -C "$PLUGIN_ROOT" show main:scripts/lib/obs_metrics.jq > /tmp/old_$$.jq 2>/dev/null; old=$(cat .agentic/observability/events-*.jsonl | jq -c "." | jq -s -f /tmp/old_$$.jq --arg mode "$m" --arg budget "" --argjson specmeta "{}" 2>/dev/null | shasum | cut -d" " -f1); [ "$new" = "$old" ] || ok=0; done; rm -f /tmp/old_$$.jq; printf '{"identical":%s}' "$ok"
